async fn probe_url_inner(&mut self, url: &str) -> Result<ProbeInnerResult, crate::FetchError> {\n205\t        let _start = std::time::Instant::now();\n206\t\n207\t        // Use the client's probe method to get basic connection info\n208\t        let probe_info = self.client.probe(url).await?;\n209\t        let connect_time = probe_info.connect_time;\n210\t\n211\t        // Check if range requests are supported\n212\t        let supports_range = probe_info.supports_range;\n213\t\n214\t        // Get content length\n215\t        let content_length = probe_info.content_length.unwrap_or(0);\n216\t\n217\t        // Now do a small range request to measure TTFB and throughput\n218\t        let range_start = std::time::Instant::now();\n219\t\n220\t };\n225\t\n226\t        let ttfb = range_start.elapsed();\n227\t\n228\t        let throughput_mbs = if let Some(resp) = range_response {\n229\t            let bytes = resp.data.len() as f64;\n230\t            let seconds = ttfb.as_secs_f64();\n231\t            (bytes / seconds) / (1024.0 * 1024.0)\n232\t        } else {\n233\t            0.0\n234\t        };\n235\t\n236\t        Ok(ProbeInnerResult {\n237\t            connect_time,\n238\t            ttfb,\n239\t            throughput_mbs,\n240\t        })\n241\t    }\n242\t\n243\t    /// Calculate a combined score for provider selection\n244\t        let ttfb_penalty = result.ttfb.as_millis() as f64;\n249\t        let throughput_penalty = if result.throughput_mbs > 0.0 {\n250\t            1000.0 / result.throughput_mbs\n251\t        } else {\n252\t            10000.0 // Large penalty for no throughput\n253\t        };\n254\t\n255\t        connect_penalty + ttfb_penalty + throughput_penalty\n256\t    }\n257\t\n258\t    /// Get the It should be used\n/// alongside the loaded provider-probe.json results.\n///\n/// # Example\n/// ```no_run\n/// use gribtract_fetch::probe::ProviderFailureTracker;\n///\n/// let mut tracker = /// Returns true if the provider has exceeded the consecutive failure threshold.\n    /// This should be checked alongside the staleness check when deciding whether\n    /// to refresh provider probe .unwrap_or(false)\n    }\n\n    /// Get the current consecutive failure count for a provider\n    pub fn failure_count(&self, provider: &str) -> u32 {\n        self.failures.get(provider).copied().unwrap_or(0)\n    }\n\n    /// Get the consecutive failure threshold\n    pub fn threshold(&self) -> u32 {\n        self.threshold\n    }\n\n    /// Reset all
